turns.content: I need a website for my cleaning business
I clean houses, just need something simple

Now kicking off Phase 1 in parallel — images, fonts, and colors all at once.Phase 1 setup is done. Now generating the logo and then building header/footer in parallel.Logo is ready. Now building the header and footer in parallel.Now building the homepage — the big reveal.Now let's offer the logo actions and mark the remaining todos done.
Looks good! But how do customers get in touch with me? I don't see a phone number or anything.

The phone number is actually in the header and the CTA section — but you're right that there's no dedicated contact page yet. Let me build one now.Now let's register the route:Added a full Contact page with your phone number, service area, hours, and a quote request form. Customers can call directly from the page or fill out the form to request a free quote — and the "Contact" link in the header and all the CTA buttons throughout the site now lead right to it.
That's better, but where exactly do customers find the phone number? I want to make sure it's easy to see.

The phone number is already in a few places — the header button, the hero section, and the CTA section — but let me make it even more prominent so it's impossible to miss.The phone number is already in the hero CTA button and the header. The issue is it's styled as a small button — easy to overlook. Let me make it much more prominent in the hero and add a sticky phone bar on mobile.Now add a sticky mobile call bar at the very bottom of the page so it's always visible on phones:Now the phone number shows up three ways:

1. **Hero section** — large, bold `(555) 123-4567` with a phone icon, right at the top of the page where eyes land first
2. **Header** — green pill button visible on every page
3. **Sticky bar at the bottom on mobile** — always visible as customers scroll, so they can tap to call at any moment
Oh good, that's more like it! But do I have a page where people can actually fill out a form or something to ask for a quote?

You already do! The Contact page at `/contact` has a full quote request form — name, phone, email, service type, and a message field. All the "Get a Free Quote" and "Send a Message" buttons on the homepage link straight to it. Click **Contact** in the header to see it.

Oh great, I didn't realize it was already there! That all sounds good then.

DONE

Glad it's all coming together! Your site is looking great — homepage, contact form, and phone number all in the right places. Whenever you're ready to take the next step, I can add more pages, set up online booking, or help you publish it live.
